provenance.built_from: the fixture's required_beats, read against the source text (Forster, The Machine Stops) and the event definition in src/extraction/pass-events.ts
provenance.blind_to: whether a candidate matched the beat. The classification was made from the beat and the definition; the recorded runs were consulted only afterwards, to compute the numbers.
provenance.author: hand-annotated (a manual read, not a judge pass — a judge pass can replace it and be compared against it)

inclusion_rule.definition: pass-events.ts: "An event is one thing that HAPPENS or CHANGES: an action, an arrival, a decision made aloud, a death, a transformation, a promise. Not a description, not a mood, not a standing fact."
inclusion_rule.non_eventful_when: the beat, as the fixture words it, contains no action, speech act, arrival or change of state or knowledge at all
eventful_when: the beat contains any happening, even alongside a mood or a description
in doubt — a beat is excluded only when it is clearly not an event, so the list errs toward a larger denominator and a lower recall_eventful
inclusion_rule.note: Classified by the beat as written, not by what the source narrates nearby. This says nothing about whether the beat matters to the story — "Cinderella does not ask to go" matters a great deal — only about whether an extractor obeying its own prompt can emit it.

non_eventful.text: Vashti's room is cataloged: buttons for food, music, clothing, hot and cold baths, literature, correspondence — the room, though it holds nothing, is in touch with everything she cares for
the air-ship service is described as a relic kept running past its usefulness, since travel itself has become nearly pointless — the earth is exactly alike everywhere now
non_eventful.why: How the air-ship service stands, and why.

non_eventful.text: the narrator states plainly what Vashti and the reader now both learn: Homelessness means death — the victim is exposed to the outer air, which kills them
non_eventful.why: The narrator defining a term. Nothing happens in the story when the reader learns it.

non_eventful.text: Kuno explains that any infant who promises undue physical strength is destroyed at birth as a demerit; he alone was let live, and it is exactly that strength that let him do what follows
non_eventful.why: Kuno describing how things generally are, which the extractor's prompt rules out by name ("a character describing … how things generally are is not an event"). Low because it is also the first time Vashti hears it.

non_eventful.text: the narrator is explicit that no one on the Central Committee understands the Machine as a whole any longer — each person masters only a fragment of it, and calls that progress
non_eventful.why: The narrator on the state of knowledge in the Committee.

non_eventful.text: her days settle back into their old rhythm: dark to sleep, light to wake, lectures given and attended, ideas exchanged with innumerable friends
non_eventful.why: A habitual routine. "Settle back" is a change only in the weakest sense.

borderline_kept_eventful.text: she recalls the Book's own line: 'Parents, duties of, cease at the moment of birth' — and reflects that there was always something special about Kuno, and about all her children
borderline_kept_eventful.why: A recollection and a reflection, but she does something: she recalls a line. Kept.

borderline_kept_eventful.text: he tells Vashti directly that it is humanity, not the surface, that is dying — that the Machine 'develops, but not on our lines' and has narrowed love itself to a carnal act
borderline_kept_eventful.why: An assertion about how things are, but made as an accusation to her face. Kept.

borderline_kept_eventful.text: from time to time a friend is granted Euthanasia and leaves their room for good; after a poorly received lecture, Vashti sometimes asks for it herself, and is refused, since the death-rate may never exceed the birth-rate
borderline_kept_eventful.why: Iterative rather than a single occurrence, but made of requests and refusals. Kept.

borderline_kept_eventful.text: the mouldy fruit, the stinking bath water, the jarring noises are all bitterly complained of at first, then quietly accepted as part of how things are — humanity proving endlessly adaptable to the Machine's decline
borderline_kept_eventful.why: A slow change, but a change. Kept.

borderline_kept_eventful.text: rumors of hope and collapse alternate — the Mending Apparatus almost mended, new 'nerve-centres' evolving — while people spend their strength praying to their Books
borderline_kept_eventful.why: Ambient and repeated, but rumours spread and people pray. Kept.
